quote: Peace begins with a deep breath and a quiet mind.

Happiness is not by chance, but by the small choices you make each day.

You do not have to carry everything at once.
A slow step is still a step forward.

Some days you bloom, some days you grow roots.
What you water today will grow tomorrow.
You are allowed to start again as many times as you need.
Calm is a skill, and you are learning it.
Not every question needs an answer today.
Your pace is still progress.
Let the hard moment pass like weather.
You have survived every difficult day so far.

Breathe in what you need, breathe out what you don't.

The smallest act of care still counts.
You can be a work in progress and still be enough.
Quiet moments hold more answers than loud ones.
Say no to one thing so you can say yes to yourself.

Leave a little room in your day for surprise.
Being present is the best way to be ready.
Let go of one worry before you sleep tonight.
